title: Explainable Deepfake Detection with Feature-robust Augmentation and Evidence-grounded Explanation Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.20913v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Explainable deepfake detection extends binary classification by requiring models to not only predict authenticity but also provide interpretable justifications. This expanded scope is critical in practice, where users like forensic analysts need insight into the rationale behind the detection. Despite advancements, current approaches suffer from two critical deficiencies: (1)vulnerability to image quality degradation: detection accuracy plummets on low-quality samples, while naive augmentation strategies may induce feature drift and impair performance as diversity expands. (2) factually flawed explanations: explanation models may omit manipulation evidence or hallucinate irrelevant details, undermining interpretability. To address it, we propose a framework with two innovations. For robust deepfake detection, we introduce Feature-robust Augmentation, which comprises diversified degradation-aware augmentation strategies, and a supervise

translated_title: 可解释的深度伪造检测：特征鲁棒增强与基于证据的解释优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20913v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：可解释的深度伪造检测扩展了二元分类任务，要求模型不仅预测真实性，还需提供可解释的论证。这一扩展范围在实践中至关重要，因为像法医分析师这样的用户需要了解检测背后的原理。尽管已有进展，当前方法仍存在两个关键缺陷：（1）对图像质量下降的脆弱性：在低质量样本上检测准确率骤降，而简单的增强策略可能引发特征漂移，随着多样性增加而损害性能。（2）事实性错误的解释：解释模型可能遗漏操纵证据或虚构无关细节，削弱可解释性。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个包含两项创新的框架。对于鲁棒的深度伪造检测，我们引入了特征鲁棒增强，其包含多样化的退化感知增强策略，以及一种监督...
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合特征鲁棒增强和基于证据的解释优化的可解释深度伪造检测框架，旨在提升低质量样本下的检测鲁棒性并生成事实准确的解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explainable deepfake detection framework with feature-robust augmentation and evidence-grounded explanation optimization, enhancing robustness on low-quality samples and producing factually accurate explanations.
